hero.title: Donate to GoGMI
hero.subtitle: Your contribution helps sustain independent maritime research, capacity building, and advocacy for a safer, more sustainable Gulf of Guinea.

research.title: Independent Research
research.desc: Funds policy briefs, reports, and strategic analysis on maritime security and the blue economy.

capacity.title: Capacity Building
capacity.desc: Supports training programmes and mentorship for the next generation of maritime professionals.

advocacy.title: Regional Advocacy
advocacy.desc: Sustains GoGMI's voice in regional dialogues shaping maritime governance and policy.

form.heading: Make a Donation
form.subheading: Every contribution, large or small, makes a difference.
form.messagePlaceholder: Leave a note with your donation
form.anonymousLabel: I'd like to donate anonymously — don't display my name publicly.
form.anonymousSubtext: We'll still keep your details on file for your receipt; they just won't be shared or shown.
form.securityNote: Payments are processed securely via Paystack. GoGMI does not store your card details.
